threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused when the bus driver shouts 'next stop' instead of the name. Real Hackney kids just nod.
Caught two blokes arguing over the last packet of crisps on the 35 last night. Turns out they were best mates just winding each other up.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a guy lugging a mariachi guitar through the park while a group of kids played handball. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only here can you catch someone busking with an accordion while a pigeon steals their sandwich, all as a U-Bahn rattles overhead.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know you’re from the Mission when you refuse to pay for a taco over $3, but you’ll happily drop $15 on a fancy coffee.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo waiting for the 21 while juggling oranges. Only in SF would that be a Tuesday morning vibe.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think they can just stroll into a bar and find ‘tapas’ for cheap. In Gràcia, it’s more about 'platillos' and the price reflects the skill behind them.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot a recent arrival by the way they still awkwardly ask locals for directions instead of just using Google Maps.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Tube' instead of just the 'Overground' when you talk about getting around. A true Hackneyite knows it's all about the overground vibe.
Last night on the 68, a guy was arguing with a sleeping cabbie about who’s got the real London accent. Just another night, I guess.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a mom calmly changing her baby on the tram floor while the driver just kept going. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find a park where friends gather to jam with instruments while kids play around abandoned trams. It feels like summer all year.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they're locals when they can spot the difference between a real taco joint and a tourist trap just by the line out the door.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Yesterday, a dog took a nap right on the Civic Center tracks, and Muni just had to wait it out. Classic SF chaos, isn't it?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always miss that the best vermut spots are tucked away in the quietest streets, not the busy plazas. It’s where locals really unwind.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They always stand confused in front of metro maps, trying to decipher the labyrinth, while locals glide past without a second glance.
